sources.entry: UnrealIRCd - Modular, advanced and highly configurable IRC server written in C for Linux, BSD, Windows, and macOS. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C

summary.one_liner: UnrealIRCd is an open-source, modular IRC server written in C that runs on Linux, macOS, BSD and Windows.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes UnrealIRCd as an IRC server with a strong focus on modularity and security, configured through an advanced, highly configurable configuration file. It lists full IRCv3 support, SSL/TLS, cloaking, JSON-RPC, anti-flood and anti-spam systems, GeoIP, and remote includes. The project says it has run networks since 1999. The README points to online documentation, a FAQ, and a support channel on irc.unrealircd.org. It also lists supported and tested operating systems, including Linux distributions, FreeBSD, and Windows 11.
use_cases: run a private or public IRC network
host an IRC server for a community
add IRCv3 and TLS-secured chat rooms
filter floods and spam on IRC channels
control an IRC server through JSON-RPC
how_to_run: Follow the installation guide on the UnrealIRCd wiki
For *NIX systems, see the 'Installing from source' instructions
For Windows, see the Windows installation instructions
notable: Highly configurable config file with remote includes
caveats: Only UnrealIRCd 6 is supported; the README says it is the only supported version
Windows support is limited to Windows 10 or later and Server 2016 or later
Installation is done from the wiki rather than a short README command set
